title: ns2jb by IZMYSH
subtitle: Original IZMYSH bootstrap. Install into the selected empty slot.
notes: First setup enters the standard bootstrap.bas (229 lines) into the selected empty slot.
LIST N:1 and SAVE "TXT:NS2I",N use the selected slot 0–3; existing NS2/NS2R files are preserved.
The new copy becomes the Launch source only after you confirm saving.
